_comment: Known failures, each with the evidence that it is NOT caused by R2a / #251 / R2b. A suite counts as known only when EVERY failing test is listed here and EVERY listed test still fails; a listed suite that passes is reported as a stale expectation and fails the matrix. Proven by running the suite on the `baseline` scenario (no R2a) with identical results on 2026-10-21. "dispositions" are explained NON-RUNS (every test skipped): they are reported by the matrix as SKIP* and lead to exit 6 at best, never 0; a disposition suite that passes is a stale expectation (exit 1).

known.reason: TW-4A pin: no pre-existing '%sms%' function may reference studio_sms_onboarding; a later TW-4F function legitimately does (count 1). Identical on the baseline without R2a.

failing: the status shows only the current attempt's evaluation events
known.reason: pins exactly 14 tw4_runner_* functions; main has 16 (stale since the financial-integrity slice, documented in TW-4F_Financial_Integrity.md section 4). Identical on the baseline without R2a.

failing: rollback parses and completes where there is no evidence
known.reason: R2b's objects depend on the R2a ledger (2BP01), so R2a's rollback cannot run until R2b is rolled back first: ordered, transaction-safe refusal, not a regression.

failing: credit retained never exceeds the payment minus refunds minus the disputes that were not won
ends at exactly payment minus refund, and every replay is acknowledged
events for payments that are not credit purchases never touch credit
known.reason: PERFORMANCE-BOUND, not a logic failure: the 60-run property test is pinned at 90 s in the test file and takes ~90 s in a container; when it times out its still-running loop pollutes the two tests after it (cascade). Passed in earlier runs on the same migrations and fails identically on `main` and every other scenario. The suite is not changed here (billing owner); rerun it singly on an idle host to confirm.

failing: the real outbox's own runner can claim and finish what P2 raised
known.reason: KI-3 (tracker section 7; Q1 #275 evidence, plain main, idle host): expected +0 to be 2. Probable cause, UNCONFIRMED: tw4_rfl_alerts_claim returns nothing while the RFL delivery kill switch is off (fail closed since 20261211) and the test never turns delivery on. The tracker records 2 of 3 tests failing; only this one is listed here, so a different failure set is reported as FAIL, not hidden. Not fixed: the cause is unconfirmed and the fix needs a platform-admin actor fixture; do NOT change the fail-closed function.

dispositions.reason: all 53 tests skip on the full chain: beforeAll refuses a database that has the real recurring-fee lifecycle (20261209+); the suite only runs on a partial R2b chain with the RFL stand-ins. Its coverage on the full chain is carried by localStack.r2brfl / tw4rfl / tw4fj1. Not a pass; re-run it only on a partial chain via `run`. On the full chain vitest exits 1 (the beforeAll refusal) with all 53 tests skipped and no failed test; the disposition applies to that exact pattern only (logMatch).
dispositions.logMatch: use an isolated database without the real recurring-fee lifecycle
